rules.route: Long Term Entry Permit, on the employer’s Immigrant Employment Certificate

others.route: Long Term Entry Permit, on the employer’s Immigrant Employment Certificate

note: Saint Helena: an employer needs the Immigration Control Board's Immigrant Employment Certificate to employ immigrants, each of whom must hold a Long Term Entry Permit (the Immigration Ordinance 2011, still in force since the 2025 amendment's commencement was revoked). Ascension's and Tristan da Cunha's own entry controls aren't modelled apart. British citizens and the other territories' passports, though of the same nationality, need it too and are named; the territory's own are home.

sources.title: St Helena Government, Immigrant Employment Certificate
sources.said: An Immigrant Employment Certificate is required by an employer to employ immigrants in St Helena and can be valid for a period of one to five years. ... Each immigrant employee must hold a Long Term Entry Permit and pass Points Based System
